note: Raises zombies (3 to 7) that follow the character and slam enemies; they cannot be hurt in Bob, so they stay until the map ends.

def.name: Raise Husk
def.description: Raises husks of the dead to fight beside you.

note: Summons a group of skeletons (3 to 8) that run at enemies and last twenty seconds.

def.name: Call Bonewalkers
def.description: Calls up a band of skeletons for twenty seconds.

note: Summons burning spirits (3 to 8) that rush at enemies for five seconds.

def.name: Call Furies
def.description: Calls up burning spirits that fly at your enemies.

note: A stone golem that fights beside the character and regenerates its life.

def.name: Stone Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of stone that regenerates your life.

note: A chaos golem that fights beside the character and lowers the physical damage taken.

def.name: Blight Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of blight that hardens you against blows.

note: A flame golem that throws fire at enemies and makes the character deal more damage.

def.name: Ember Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of embers that makes you hit harder.

note: An ice golem that fights beside the character and gives it critical strike chance and accuracy.

def.name: Rime Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of frost that sharpens your strikes.

note: A lightning golem that shoots enemies and quickens the character's attacks and casting.

def.name: Storm Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of storm that quickens you.

note: A carrion golem that fights beside the character and adds physical damage to its minions (folded into the character's added damage).

def.name: Carrion Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of carrion that adds physical damage to your hits.

note: A relic that follows the character, shoots at enemies and regenerates the character's life.

def.name: Hallowed Relic
def.description: Raises a relic that fires holy light and mends you.

note: Two motes that follow the character and make shocks and chills stronger (the auras on enemies are folded into the character's ailment effect).

def.name: Whirring Motes
def.description: Motes that follow you and make shocks and chills stronger.

note: Raises one or two bound shades that follow the character and fire chaos bolts at enemies (Bob's shades stand in for the reference's raised monsters).

def.name: Bind Shade
def.description: Binds shades of the dead to fight for you.

note: Animates a few blades that fight for the character for a long while.

def.name: Wake Blades
def.description: Wakes blades to fight for you.

note: Animates a guardian that fights beside the character.

def.name: Wake Sentinel
def.description: Wakes a sentinel to guard you.

note: Fires an arrow that leaves a shadow archer for three seconds.

def.name: Shadow Quiver
def.description: Leaves a shadow archer that fires beside you.

note: Fires an arrow that leaves a mirrored archer for three seconds.

def.name: Mirror Quiver
def.description: Leaves a mirrored archer that fires beside you.

note: An offering cast when enemies are near that gives block chance for a few seconds (the corpse is not used here).

def.name: Bone Ward Rite
def.description: An offering of bone that raises your guard.

note: An offering cast when enemies are near that quickens attacks, casting and movement for a few seconds.

def.name: Flesh Surge Rite
def.description: An offering of flesh that quickens you.

note: An offering cast when enemies are near that gives resistances and chaos damage from physical for a few seconds.

def.name: Spirit Ward Rite
def.description: An offering of spirit that warms your resolve.

note: The supported minions deal more damage.

def.name: Pack Fury
def.description: Minions deal more damage.

note: The supported minions are sturdier; Bob's minions cannot be hurt, so the extra life is folded into more minion damage.

def.name: Hardy Pack
def.description: Sturdier minions that stay in the fight.

note: The supported minions strike and move faster.

def.name: Pack Haste
def.description: Minions strike and move faster.

note: The supported minions stay close to the character and take less damage; here they hit harder against enemies near the character.

def.name: Warding Pack
def.description: Minions guard you and fight harder near you.

note: The supported minions deal more elemental damage and shrug off elements (the exposure is dropped).

def.name: Elemental Pack
def.description: Minions hit harder with elemental damage.

note: The supported minions make the character stronger as they hit (folded into more minion damage and speed).

def.name: Frenzied Pack
def.description: Minions fight in a frenzy.

note: The supported minions burn the ground around them; here they simply deal more damage.

def.name: Burning Pack
def.description: Minions are wreathed in fire and deal more damage.
